name: fig1_submerged_fraction.png
caption: Submerged fraction vs centre height for 2-D circular disk and 3-D sphere. The green dashed line marks the ice/water density ratio (equilibrium condition).

name: fig2_buoyancy_force.png
caption: Buoyancy force vs centre height for 2-D disk (left) and 3-D sphere (right). The horizontal dashed line shows the particle weight; the intersection gives the floating equilibrium.

name: fig3_wetted_area.png
caption: Wetted surface area vs centre height for 2-D circular cylinder (left) and 3-D sphere (right).

name: fig4_floating_equilibrium.png
caption: Floating equilibrium of a 2-D circular disk (ice floe). G marks the centre of gravity, B the centre of buoyancy. The green line shows the waterplane width.

name: fig5_heave_stiffness.png
caption: Heave restoring stiffness vs density ratio. Positive stiffness confirms vertical (heave) stability for all floating configurations. The green line marks the ice/water density ratio.

name: fig6_wave_force.png
caption: Wave force time series on a floating ice particle at equilibrium. Top: surface elevation; bottom: horizontal and vertical Morison wave forces.
